K-type Retaining Ring

A relatively new type of retaining ring designed to be easy to install and remove while still withstanding strong axial (thrust) loads. Its multiple spring-lug structure distributes the load, providing a larger contact area than standard C-type or E-type rings. The spec symbol is designated T5304 / 5304.
